title: Active tiers come first by number, archived tiers after A to Z
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses, archived, whose name starts with Y (for example Yellow Fleet).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier D, with a name no other tier uses, archived, whose name starts with B (for example Blue Fleet).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Default, then the other active tiers in number order (tier A before tier B), come first.
  • After the last active tier come the archived tiers, tier D before tier C (B before Y).
  • Tier C and tier D show no number and the status Archived.
